worldcombat.skill.electroweb.summary: Throws a live electric net onto a chosen spot: foes that step in are jolted, lose Speed and are briefly pinned, and those still inside keep getting shocked. Overcharge is narrower and meaner with a harder lock; Wide lays a broader, longer net.
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.use.0: Pre-set a net on the path a foe must take
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.use.1: Seal an area and force foes around it
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.use.2: Pin a target that charges in
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.use.3: Shock several foes spread around a spot
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.description: A foe stepping in takes about %1$s special damage; the target's special defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The net opens to about %1$s blocks and stays live for %2$s; it only lands on legal ground and disperses with no support, allies pass through freely and only foes are jolted.
A jolted target loses %1$s Speed stage(s) and is pinned where it stands, unable to move, for %2$s as it enters.
Those still inside take about %1$s special damage every %2$s s; a caught foe's movement speed is heavily reduced, and the hold drags on for %3$s after leaving.
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.option.on: Overcharge on: the net is about x0.72 wide, lasts about x0.75, the first jolt about x1.3 stronger and one extra Speed stage dropped, with +2 ticks wind-up and +8 ticks cooldown, for a painful lock on one target.
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.option.off: Overcharge off (Wide): the net lays broader, lasts longer and casts faster, at the cost of about x1.0 first jolt and one Speed stage, for sealing an area and letting foes walk in.
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.timing: Throw the net onto a spot within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.electroweb.growth.0: At level %1$s the first jolt rises to %2$s power and the net to %3$s blocks.
On: the net narrows to about x0.72, lasts about x0.75, the first jolt about x1.3 stronger and one extra Speed stage dropped, with a longer wind-up and cooldown, for a painful lock on one target. Off: a broader, longer, faster net for sealing an area and letting foes walk in.
The companion only lays a net on a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher sets the net further along the foe's path.
Lay the net only when at least this many foes stand within 3 blocks of the target; 1 means lay it as soon as one is seen.
Lead a moving target by this many ticks when placing the net; 0 drops it where the target stands, higher is better against a charging foe.
world_combat.move.electroweb.text.fizzle: No ground to hold the net; it scattered
